Hi Product Hunt. I'm José, a software engineer with over 25 years of experience ( I kept losing tasks I said out loud: mid-meeting, in the car, walking the dog. Foley is the to-do list I wanted for that. You talk, and it files. It handles time the way people say it ("next Tuesday morning"), and it asks when it isn't sure instead of guessing. When plans change, say so and it moves the task. Ask it to plan your day, or what to work on first, and it answers from your own list. The desktop app is free with no account, using your own OpenRouter key. Foley Pro is $8 a month on the web, and your first month there is $4, applied at checkout. I'll be here all day.
